firstAha.scope: current filtered source rows before area focus
firstAha.ranking: top three fixed neighborhoods by distinct brand labels, POS count, stable ID
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {areaCount} ย่านรวม {sharePercent}% ของแบรนด์
firstAha.numerator: union of distinct source brand labels assigned to top neighborhoods
firstAha.denominator: all distinct brand labels in the filtered rows, including rows outside defined neighborhoods
firstAha.action: สำรวจ {areaCount} ย่าน
requirements: No login, sharing or geolocation prerequisite
Core dataset and neighborhood boundaries enable area Aha; core counts/table still work without boundaries; optional map/chart vendors load separately
Same source-row set drives map, counters, charts and table
Returning to all clears only area focus

data.observationGrain: one declared brand store/counter/POS observation; repeated source records are not silently merged
data.closurePolicy: Retain permanently closed records and factual closure status; exclude from default current view; never delete to improve counts
data.coordinatePolicy: Preserve original geographic coordinates; any marker displacement is screen-space only

layout.charts: collapsed bottom tray, open on demand
layout.mobile: full map with compact first insight and bottom data sheet

invariants.rule: One store observation owns one pin; no clustering or aggregation
250 logo labels is a ceiling, never a quota; collision avoidance wins
Preserve original logo artwork; use verified local sprite and restrained framing
Default first insight concerns neighborhoods, not venues
Never sum distinct brands across areas; use set union
Keep generic caveats and workflow notes out of UI; retain provenance in documentation and real closure/error states
No decorative bracket or colored left rail; keep visible focus
No fabricated coordinates, store openings, administrative boundaries or consumer behavior claims
Every visible count and action must respect the same selected source rows
